RIGHT SIDE: the wife remaining on the grey fabric sofa in the living room, her back to the camera, long straight black hair down her back, fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, the TV's cool white-blue light washing over her. Center: the door frame and the wall in between. Warm yellow-white light on the left bedroom side, cool TV backlight on the right living room side. Mood: the temporary split, the brief separation before the summons chain begins. Text watermark 'P14-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
